title: Crop Calendar Provision on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Late Charges
content:
**Provision.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans late charge is multiplied by a seasonal factor set by the calendar month of the installment's due date: 0.8 for a due date in September, October or November, when harvest receipts are not yet in, 0.9 for a due date in March, April or May, when planting costs fall due, and 1.0 for a due date in any other month. The multiplication is made on the charge as figured, before any rounding; only the final product is rounded to cents, and the minimum and maximum late charge apply to that rounded figure.

## Factor by month of the due date

| Month of the installment's due date | Season | Seasonal factor |
|---|---|---|
| September, October, November | harvest receipts not yet in | 0.8 |
| March, April, May | planting costs fall due | 0.9 |
| January, February, June, July, August, December | — | 1.0 |

## Points of judgement

- The month is that of the installment's due date, not of the day the charge is booked: an installment due 30 November and charged in December takes 0.8.
- Hypothetical: a charge figured at 150.00 on an installment due 10 April is multiplied by 0.9 to 135.00 before rounding.
- An installment due 31 August takes 1.0; one due 1 September takes 0.8.
